text:
eli_support: Customer (Acme Logistics GmbH) reports they should be VAT-exempt under reverse charge. They provided VAT ID DE123456789 and attached a PDF. VIES lookup shows INVALID. Invoice INV-2026-0421 is pending and the customer is asking us to remove VAT. Can billing advise?

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 status: PENDING_PAYMENT. Billing contact: billing@acme.example. Tax flag: VAT_APPLIED (20%). VAT Number: DE123456789 (validation=false). Attachments: vat_confirmation_acme.pdf.

marcus_billing: Can you paste the exact VAT number they gave (full string incl country code)? and confirm billing country?

eli_support: They provided: DE123456789. Billing country: DE (Germany). Customer says the confirmation came from Bundeszentralamt f\u00fcr Steuern (BZSt).

marcus_billing: Quick notes: VIES occasionally returns INVALID for newly issued numbers or propagation delays. DE numbers are 9 digits so format looks OK. I tried a VIES check from my laptop and got INVALID as well.

anna_tax: For EU reverse charge we require either (A) a successful VIES validation, or (B) an official confirmation from the national tax authority (e.g., BZSt certificate), or (C) a signed resale/certificate that proves business status with tax number. General docs (bank stmt, business registration) are not sufficient on their own.

sarah_custsuccess: Customer asked if a "Gewerbeanmeldung" + VAT number screenshot counts. They can produce the BZSt confirmation but it might be a scanned letter, not the VIES response.

anna_tax: A scanned BZSt confirmation is acceptable if it clearly shows the VAT ID and is issued by the authority. We need to store the document in the billing ticket as evidence.

eli_support: Can we manually override the VIES check in our billing UI to mark the invoice VAT-exempt while legal reviews the doc? The customer is requesting immediate exemption before payment.

marcus_billing: We can do a temporary manual override, but it requires a finance sign-off and the evidence must be attached. Standard process: create a billing ticket, attach the national confirmation, set invoice to HOLD and set tax_exempt = true (temporary). I'll need approval from Finance lead. Risk: auditors will want the evidence within our retention window.

oliver_engineer: If you need the admin API to mark it, we have an endpoint (admins only). Example cURL to apply a manual tax override: ```bash
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.example/admin/invoices/INV-2026-0421/actions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"tax_override","tax_override":true,"reason":"manual override - awaiting BZSt confirmation"}'
```
Note: only roles with admin scope can call this. The frontend also has a "Mark as tax-exempt (manual)" button for finance users.

marcus_billing: @eli_support please open a BILL ticket with the PDF attached and ping me. I can approve a 48h temporary hold while we validate.

eli_support: Ticket created: BILL-792. Uploaded vat_confirmation_acme.pdf (scanned BZSt letter). Pinged @marcus_billing.

marcus_billing: Approved temporary hold (48h) pending tax review. I set invoice flag: temporary_hold_48h and left audit_note.

invoice-bot: Audit log: manual_override applied by marcus_billing at 1759803000. note: temporary_hold_48h.

anna_tax: I'll review the scanned BZSt doc. If the VAT number on the certificate matches DE123456789 and issuer is BZSt, we can accept reverse charge and update invoice to VAT_EXEMPT. Expect update within 24h.

sarah_custsuccess: Customer notified about the 48h hold and is relieved. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:. I'll follow up for the final confirmation and close the loop.

eli_support: Leaving this thread open until anna confirms. If we need to revoke the override later, ping me.

anna_tax: Reviewed the PDF quickly: matches VAT ID and looks genuine. I'll finalize the acceptance and instruct billing to mark INV-2026-0421 as VAT_EXEMPT and record source=BZSt-scanned-cert in the audit trail.

marcus_billing: Done. Invoice updated to VAT_EXEMPT, evidence attached in BILL-792. Closing the temporary hold.

eli_support: Closing here — customer notified and invoice corrected.
